review_scope: Environment necessity and relevant primary-source claims/comments; executable SQL independently checked only for ready items. Long stack frames are retained but not treated as extra setup instructions.
prior_gaps: cmain明确WITH_DEBUG=1、ASAN、UBSAN、Boost1.77；当前仅release镜像。不能把stock结果当所述构建已验证。

requirements: 全新隔离 schema 和专用会话；保存真实版本、sql_mode、字符集和日志

original_oracle.normal: BIT 1 真值为真；第一查询零行，第二 SUM 为 0，不应返回 1。
original_oracle.reported: 在所列前提成立时，违反上述逐例结果/错误/存活约束才记录异常；保存原始输出，初始化失败单列。
prerequisites: 全新隔离 schema 和专用会话；保存真实版本、sql_mode、字符集和日志

required_environment: record sql_mode, optimizer_switch, character sets, version and warnings
build_necessity: Reported Debug/ASan/UBSan is source environment; no assertion/debug variable/sanitizer diagnostic is needed to observe this specific wrong-result/error pattern. Release result is explicitly an alternate-build observation; a negative cannot rule out the original instrumented build.

oracle.reported_pattern: After CREATE VIEW, first SELECT has zero rows and scalar SUM=1 is reported; NOT bit 1 should be false and SUM=0.
oracle.normal: Both computations agree, or documented valid DDL/view works with required controls.
oracle.classification_rule: reproduced only when exact report pattern and controls hold; otherwise not_reproduced only after all required statements complete, unexpected error -> execution_failed, different anomaly -> other_anomaly.
